scope: Review of an uncommitted selected unused modern MLINESTYLE one-to-zero edit. The exploratory implementation was reversed; existing unchanged zero-count transport is a separate route.

witness.result: Original PeerRetarget style has one element and no selected audit errors. Both proposed zero-element outputs, and independently peer-authored zero, are flagged by ezdxf 1.4.5 with INVALID_MLINESTYLE_ELEMENT_COUNT (216) for the selected style. The auditor may report the same object twice via distinct traversal paths; duplicate reports are not independent failures.

audit.note: Autodesk DXF identifies group 71 as the element count but does not itself specify a zero-element admission rule. ezdxf explicitly flags an empty element list.

decision: Retain atomic refusal of the 1→0 edit until distinguishing target-consumer evidence justifies changing it. Do not rerun this unchanged audit; pursue a different witnessed remaining P2 operation. This decision does not alter the pre-existing unchanged-zero transport path.
limitations: Peer audit rejection is a concrete interoperability finding, not proof that AutoCAD itself refuses the record or that one-element styles are universally valid.
Successful raw readback is not native rendering or application acceptance.
All test input and output drawings remain in ignored scratch; no external fixture was committed.
